title: goof balls - agar.io meets rock, paper, scissors
author: Content_Pineapple455
selftext:
[https://balls.tapp.inc](https://balls.tapp.inc)

The original idea came from a martial-arts manga (Kenichi: The Mightiest Disciple) I read in high school. There was a scene where two masters played rock-paper-scissors at an absurd speed, watching each other and changing their hands at the last possible moment. For some reason, that idea never left my brain.

Years later, this is what I came up with lol.  I also combined it with the simple Fire/Grass/Water triangle that I loved from the original Pokémon games

Premise: You’re dropped into a shrinking ring with a bunch of little balls. Switch elements to counter your opponents, rush into the ones you beat, shield when you’re in trouble, and try to be the last goof ball standing. 

I also made it so you can play solo against bots or create a private room and play with friends! (Added chat so you can trash talk them a bit too)

It’s still being tuned, broken, and improved, so I’d love to hear what you think. I have a lot of ideas for things to add here so be on the lookout for some more additions as time goes on.
